ERR-003 • Blacksburg, Virginia & Haven City / Seattle, Washington • 2000–Present (Signed 2001, formerly working title "Mirage")

The Paper Wall

Cinematic Literary Rock Operas & Alternative Industrial Sanctuary

Engine Room Records' first outside signing (2001). Formed by Julian Croft ("Leo") and Maya Sterling ("Olivia") alongside Julian's sisters and cousins, The Paper Wall transforms survival, disability rights, and found-family sanctuary into multi-volume literary rock operas.

What Kind of Music Is The Paper Wall? Emotionally raw theatrical rock operas, dynamic quiet-to-loud alternative rock builds, industrial percussion, and autobiographical storytelling across multi-book concept albums.

Canonical In-Universe History

1. Canonical Band Lore & Sanctuary History

October 2000 at Kincaid Hall: "We're Going to Build an Engine, Too"

In October 2000, nineteen-year-old Julian Croft—newly arrived at CPI after escaping his abuser ("Vanessa")—rolled into the back of Kincaid Hall during orientation. Watching Ryan O'Connell command 60,000 Ironheads from his wheelchair during "Ignition (The Forger's Call)" surrounded by his protective family, Julian gripped Maya's hand and realized he did not need to be "cured" to command a stage: "We're going to build an engine, too."

Why the Band Is Named "The Paper Wall" (The SSI/Medicaid Marriage Penalty)

Julian Croft and Maya Sterling live as a devoted married couple, yet remain legally single on paper. Under restrictive federal disability statutes, legal marriage would immediately strip Julian of his SSI and Medicaid coverage—a catastrophic loss of life-sustaining care. Holly O'Connell drafted a specialized special-needs and IP asset protection trust—colloquially called "The Paper Wall"—allowing Engine Room Records, LLC to fund their housing, touring, and medical autonomy without disqualifying Julian's benefits.

Static & Silence (Books 1 & 2) & The Pasco Lock

Released in 2001, the two-volume rock opera Static & Silence (Book 1: The Long Road West and Book 2: The Journey Home) chronicles Julian's harrowing escape—from "The Pasco Lock" and "Curbstone, 4 AM" to "165 to Burien," "A TTY Lifeline," and "Sanctuary."

Original Archival Dossier
ROSTER ID: ERR-003

THE PAPER WALL

ORIGIN: BLACKSBURG, VA | SIGNED: 2001

Status:
ACTIVE / TOURING

The Mission Profile

The Paper Wall (originally formed under the working title Mirage) is not just a band; it is a survival mechanism. Formed by Julian Croft and Maya Sterling, the collective blends the scale of cinematic literary rock opera with the raw grit of industrial and alternative rock.

The "Paper Wall" Legal Trust

Julian Croft (Lead Vocals) and Maya Sterling (Percussion) live as a married couple but remain legally single. Under current disability laws, marriage would strip Julian of his SSI and Medicaid—a death sentence for his care.

Engine Room Records does not just distribute their music. We fund the "Paper Wall" legal trust that protects their assets and independence—and gave the band its permanent name.

The "Safe Harbor" Lineup

  • Julian Croft ("Leo")
    Lead Vocals / Composition
  • Maya Sterling ("Olivia")
    Percussion / Vocals / Care Partner
  • The Sisters (Luna, Stella, Charlie): Izzy, Bea, Charlotte Croft
  • The Cousins (Enforcers): Diana Hale, Ellie Cross, Fiona Croft

Archive: The Meeting

DATE: OCTOBER 2000
LOC: CPI CAMPUS / KINCAID HALL

Julian Croft was 19, attempting to restart his life after escaping his abuser ("Vanessa"). He rolled into the back of Kincaid Hall during a CPI Orientation event, unsure if he belonged.

On stage, Ryan O'Connell—The Stardust Engine's T10 paraplegic frontman—was strapped into his chair, sweating, screaming, and dominating the room with the band's anthem, Ignition (The Forger's Call).

Julian watched Ryan command 60,000 "Ironheads" without standing up. He watched the O'Connell siblings and Wright twins operate as a single, protective unit.

Julian grabbed Maya's hand. He realized he didn't need to be "cured" to be on stage. He turned to her and said:
"We're going to build an engine, too."
